description:
"Honor your pact and let loose your rage.

Increases the amount of Fury you generate by |cffffff5|r.
Current Bonus: |cffffff15|r

Fury is generated by using Werewolf abilities while in combat. Once you have |cffffff1000|r, you gain access to the Rampage Ultimate, which increases your damage done by |cffffff15|r%, Movement Speed by |cffffff20|r%, and removes the cost of all Werewolf abilities for |cffffff20|r seconds."
